path: 上達のためのテクニック

title.ja: 舟囲いから守りと攻めの手を選ぶ
title.en: Choose the Next Move from a Boat Castle

intro.ja: 舟囲いは居飛車の玉を左へ移し、少ない手数で戦いに備える形です。銀を７九に残すか、６八で働かせるか、５七まで出すかで攻めと守りの利きが変わります。金を寄せる箱入り娘やエルモ囲いも、同じ玉の周辺で守る場所を変える選択です。囲いの名前だけでは強さを決めず、相手の飛車筋と駒同士の支えを確かめます。
intro.en: Boat castle moves a Static Rook king left and prepares for contact in relatively few moves. Leaving the silver on ７九, using it on ６八, or advancing it to ５七 changes both attack and defense. Boxed-in Daughter and Elmo shift a gold to cover different squares near the same king. Judge the opponent's rook line and connected defenders rather than assuming a named shape is always strong.

question.ja: 舟囲いの銀を６八から５七へ出す前に、何を比較しますか？
question.en: What should you compare before moving a Boat-castle silver from ６八 to ５七?

answer.ja: ５七から狙える前方のマスと、６八にいた銀が守っていたマスを比べます。銀５七を金が支えるか、相手の飛車が空いた筋に入れるかも調べます。
answer.en: Compare the forward squares attacked from ５七 with the squares the silver defended from ６八. Also check whether a gold supports the advanced silver and whether an opened line admits the opponent's rook.

title.ja: 金を上げる一手で舟の形を作る
title.en: One gold move completes the basic Boat shelter

text.ja: 玉７八、角８八、銀７九、金６九・５九、飛車２八です。玉は飛車から離れていますが、金５九はまだ玉の高さに達していません。金を一段上げて、守るマスを数えます。
text.en: Sente has a king on ７八, bishop on ８八, silver on ７九, golds on ６九 and ５九, and rook on ２八. The king is away from the rook, but the gold on ５九 has not yet reached the king's rank. Raise it and count the resulting defended squares.

text.ja: ▲５八金。玉７八は銀７九と金６九に守られ、金６九は金５八を斜め前から支えます。これは舟囲いの基本的な配置です。短い手数で形ができますが、この盤には上部の歩がないため、実戦では攻めを始める前に相手の利きを調べます。
text.en: ▲５八金 completes a basic Boat arrangement. The silver on ７九 and gold on ６九 protect the king on ７八, while the gold on ６九 supports the gold on ５八 diagonally forward. It takes little time to form, but this board lacks an upper pawn screen; inspect opposing attacks before starting your own.

title.ja: 銀を前へ出すと守るマスも変わる
title.en: Advancing the silver changes its defensive squares

text.ja: 玉７八、角８八、金５八・６九、銀６八の舟囲い型です。後手の歩４六が進んでおり、銀を５七へ出すとその歩を狙えます。銀を７九に残す形なら玉７八を直接守りますが、６八の銀はすでに別のマスを見ています。
text.en: Sente has a Boat-style king on ７八, bishop on ８八, golds on ５八 and ６九, and silver on ６八. Gote's pawn on ４六 is a target if the silver advances to ５七. A silver left on ７九 would directly protect the king on ７八; this silver on ６八 already covers a different set of squares.

text.ja: ▲５七銀。銀は歩４六を狙い、金５八が銀５七を守ります。一方、銀６八が押さえていた７七・６七への利きはなくなります。５七銀型で攻めを急ぐなら、その空いたマスを後手が使えるかを同時に確かめます。
text.en: ▲５七銀 attacks the pawn on ４六, and the gold on ５八 protects the silver. It no longer covers ７七 or ６七 as it did from ６八. When using the ５七 silver for a faster attack, check whether Gote can exploit those vacated defensive squares.

title.ja: 金を寄せると飛車筋の受け先が変わる
title.en: A gold shift changes where the rook line meets resistance

text.ja: 玉７八、銀７九、金６九・５八に対し、後手飛車４八が八段目を見ています。今は金５八が飛車の横利きを止めています。金を６八へ寄せると、玉の隣は厚くなりますが、飛車筋がどこまで伸びるかも変わります。
text.en: Gote's rook on ４八 looks across the eighth rank toward a king on ７八, silver on ７九, and golds on ６九 and ５八. The gold on ５八 currently blocks the rook. Moving it toward ６八 thickens the area beside the king, but also changes how far the rook line extends.

text.ja: ▲６八金で箱入り娘型です。金６八は金６九と銀７九に守られ、飛車４八の筋は５八を通って６八で止まります。玉７八の隣に駒が増えた反面、玉が動ける６八の空きマスはなくなりました。固さだけでなく、王手を受けたときの逃げ道も比べます。
text.en: ▲６八金 makes a Boxed-in Daughter arrangement. The gold on ６八 is protected by the gold on ６九 and silver on ７九; the rook's line now runs through ５八 and stops at ６八. The king gains a neighboring defender but loses the empty escape square on ６八. Compare escape routes as well as local protection.

title.ja: エルモ型では下段から銀を支える
title.en: Elmo supports the silver from the lower rank

text.ja: 玉７八、銀６八、金６九・５九です。後手飛車４八の横利きは５八を通って銀６八に届きます。金６九は銀６八を守っていますが、金を７九へ寄せても銀との連結を保てるか調べます。
text.en: Sente has king ７八, silver ６八, and golds ６九 and ５九. Gote's rook on ４八 reaches the silver on ６八 through the empty ５八. The gold on ６九 protects the silver now; check whether shifting it to ７九 preserves that connection.

text.ja: ▲７九金でエルモ囲い型になります。金７九と金５九はいずれも銀６八を斜め前に守り、金７九は玉７八も支えます。飛車が銀６八を取る順は金で取り返せる形ですが、相手の別の利きや持ち駒が加われば再計算が必要です。
text.en: ▲７九金 gives an Elmo-style shape. Golds on ７九 and ５九 both protect the silver on ６八 diagonally forward, and the gold on ７九 also supports the king on ７八. A rook capture of that silver can be recaptured by a gold in this position; added attackers or pieces in hand would require a fresh calculation.
